"1. Download Android Platform Tools from Android Developers and open a terminal in the platform-tools folder.
2. Enable USB debugging in Developer options. Connect your phone to the computer and confirm the RSA fingerprint on the phone.
3. Check that your phone is listed.

Windows PowerShell:
.\adb.exe devices

macOS / Linux:
./adb devices

4. Run the command for your operating system.

Windows PowerShell:
%1$s

macOS / Linux:
%2$s

5. Wait for %3$s, then connect the phone to %4$s.

The command uses your current audio and phone display settings. Activate again after rebooting or updating HSD. Android 17 may need Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging to restore the independent display service."
